in_hindi.name: नभन्यु
in_hindi.meaning: नभ: समुद्र, न्यु: जानना, यु: होना
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who knows or is born in the middle of the water (ocean)

in_tamil.name: நப்பானியு
in_tamil.meaning: நப்: Sky, பா: Born, அனியு: New

in_marathi.name: Nabhanyu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Newborn, Young One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nabhanyu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Nabha’ (navel) and ‘Anyu’ (new). This name symbolizes a new beginning, a fresh start, and a young one.

in_bengali.name: Nabhanyu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Newborn, Young One
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nabhanyu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Nabha’ (navel) and ‘Anyu’ (new). This name symbolizes a new beginning, a fresh start, and a young one.
